findings.reason: the node must be told to measure a pointer written by a dispatch that has launched (or to exempt the queued shape), otherwise it either reports the measure unmet or removes a field the queue still reads and breaks the queue.
findings.text: the done-when requires that "a pointer written by a test dispatch is under 12 KB and carries none of the moved fields" and that "after the third node lands, a pointer written by a real dispatch carries none of them", but the section's own design (plan.html:79-80) says `dispatch_options` "is moved when the request launches, since a queued request launches from it and `queue_admission.py` and `queue_edit.py` read it until then", and `_queued_request_record` writes the whole `dispatch_options` — including its nested `picker_selection` — into the record `queue_dispatch` stores as a live pointer (`"dispatch_options": dict(dispatch_options or {})`, reckon/crew/dispatch.py:249; stored through `pointer_path`/`read_pointer` at reckon/crew/runs.py:720), so a dispatch that queues (the ordinary case when a lane is held) writes a pointer that does carry a moved field; the clause is unsatisfiable as stated and a node that closes it by moving `dispatch_options` off the queued pointer breaks `queue_admission.py:276`, `:383`, `:1130`, `:3543` and `queue_edit.py:177`, `:410`, `:528`, which read it there — and the "real dispatch" half adds the same exposure, since a real dispatch is queued exactly when the lane is full

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — commit 31091b24c and branch preserve/dispatch-detail-moves-off-the-live-pointer both resolve (git cat-file -t: commit; branch present locally and on origin), all sixteen named reader modules exist, `_record_suite_evidence` is at reckon/crew/queue_landing.py:356 with its write at :371, `_crew_rows` reads `node` at reckon/serve.py:888-890, and the three cited test reads resolve at tests/test_the_landing_pass_measures_and_lands.py:309, :341 and :782.
rubric_items.done_when: a finding — the section's done-when asserts that a pointer written by a dispatch "carries none of the moved fields" without qualifying that the dispatch has launched, while the section's own mechanism keeps `dispatch_options` on a queued pointer.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — the bound and the residual sizes are recorded in the node's committed evidence fragment, and the earlier objection that "recorded with each pointer's size" named no durable path is answered.
rubric_items.naming: pass — s2 names no plan label, stage name or ticket number in a symbol or a code path; file, module and commit references are mechanism references.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — the cited measurements hold (re-counted today: `suite_evidence` 158,289 bytes, `dispatch_options` 42,310, and the declared set's removal leaves a largest live pointer of 17,884 bytes ≈ the "18 KB" the section reports), so the root cause matches its evidence, but the mechanism the section describes terminates at launch while the done-when measures a dispatch that may never launch; see the done_when finding.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — the section carries one goal (live pointer holds only live facts, read through one accessor), and each of its three nodes takes one slice of that one goal.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — s2 declares no section dependency and needs none (the six-field move is independent of the station); the intra-section ordering it does rely on is stated ("three nodes in order"), and the third node's sequencing uses `--after`, which exists as a real dispatch option (reckon/crew_dispatch_commands.py:1102), so the earlier "no waiting is declared" finding is answered.
